moves.text: Keep Ollie Gordon II at FLEX over Mike Evans; Evans has no late-swap path this week
moves.why: Gordon (13.8 @ BUF) and every other WR/FLEX starter lock at 1 PM, while SF's inactives come out about 6:50 PM, well after that. To use Evans (11.5 vs MIN, 8:20 PM) you'd have to start him before 1 PM, on a Q tag (Achilles) after one limited practice Thu, his first since Week 6. ESPN's only update says he's 'reportedly ready to return' (Rapoport). He projects 2.3 below Gordon, so leave him benched.

moves.text: Keep Brock Purdy at QB over Bryce Young (17.6 vs 17.4); decide before 1 PM if you want Young
moves.why: ESPN lists both as healthy. Young had a sore foot Wed but practiced fully. Young (vs BAL) locks at 1 PM, and once it passes Purdy (vs MIN in Mexico City, 8:20 PM) is the only option. The 0.2-point gap is noise. Purdy also stacks with Kittle and the 49ers D/ST in the same game, which helps you most in a matchup projected 117.6-116.2.

moves.text: For Week 12, check waivers for a WR and cut Mendoza or the Vikings D/ST after tonight
moves.why: Your only WRs are Moore, Tyson and Evans (Q). Meanwhile the bench carries 3 QBs (Purdy, Young, Mendoza), 2 D/STs and 2 Ks (Shrader 1-for-3 Thu, Dicker). ESPN shows no byes in Week 12, so the spot is worth more as WR depth. Drop only after Mendoza (4:25 PM) and the Vikings (8:20 PM) have played. Shrader vs Dicker can wait until Muse posts Week 12 projections.

moves.text: Keep Jordyn Tyson at WR2; he has no injury designation for Sun @ CHI
moves.why: Tyson (11.8 @ CHI) was limited earlier in the week with a chest injury but ESPN shows no Q tag and reports no designation for Sunday. If a 1 PM scratch somehow hits, Evans (Q, 11.5 vs MIN, 8:20 PM) is the only WR fallback.
